text:
maria (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the Private Deploy roadmap for Q3. Main asks: customer-managed networking (VPC peering / BYO-NAT), a zero-downtime upgrade lane for operator/installer users, and clear launch criteria for GA. Thoughts?

alex (Eng): +1 on prioritizing the upgrade lane. Customers keep hitting the ‘upgrade breaks egress IP’ story.

lisa (Field): ACME and Nimbus both flagged IP preservation as a blocking item. They run strict firewall rules and can only change allowed IPs on a quarterly window.

netops-jordan: Can confirm. Two patterns: 1) preserve static egress IPs for tenant pods, or 2) provide a relay NAT in customer VPC. Both have tradeoffs (ops complexity vs. network path).

sam (SRE): Also need rollout automation: canary across tenants, automatic fallback to hosted runtime if onprem capacity fails, and health-check-driven rollback.

maria (PM): Proposal: split into three lanes — Minimal installer (fast GA), Operator shim (upgrade-friendly, supports canary), and Full VPC-handoff (longer effort for BYO-NAT/IP-preserve). We should define acceptance criteria per lane.

alex (Eng): Minimal installer ACs: offline bundle, basic telemetry opt-in, KMS integration doc; rollout plan: customer acceptance test (CAT) + 2-week canary. Operator shim ACs: stateful KV cache migration, seamless node swap with KV hot-transfer, smoke tests for existing models.

lisa (Field): For Full VPC-handoff, field needs: documented IP-preserve-mode, peering playbook, and an ops-runbook for customers to verify connectivity. Also cost estimate for relay NAT option.

netops-jordan: Technical notes: IP-preserve-mode requires either: 1) BGP-managed egress (hard), 2) sticky SNAT via gateway appliance, or 3) egress-relay that terminates TLS in our infra — option 3 has compliance concerns. Need legal + security input.

maria (PM): Good flag. Add security review to the dependencies. Recommend we target Minimal installer GA by X (2 sprints) and Operator shim as Beta (4 sprints). Full VPC-handoff as Q4 epic.

sam (SRE): Can we define "zero-downtime" more concretely? For us: <1% 5xx errors during upgrade, KV miss rate <0.5% across canary, and rollback path under 10 minutes.

alex (Eng): Agree. Also add smoke test: run a 30m regen workload against both old and new operator instances and verify token-latency P50 change <10ms.

lisa (Field): Customers require a documented rollback checklist + emergency contact (SE oncall + engineering runbook). If we can promise <2 hour support SLA for upgrade windows, field teams can sell the upgrade.

maria (PM): Action items:
- Alex: spike operator shim flow (POC + PR) that demonstrates KV hot-transfer and node swap. Deliverable in 2 weeks.
- Netops-Jordan: enumerate network patterns and security tradeoffs; write short risk matrix. 1 week.
- Sam: draft canary automation + rollback playbook. 2 weeks.
- Lisa: collect field customer constraints and prioritize top 5 accounts for early beta. 1 week.

alex (Eng): I'll throw up a repo and paste a demo script. Preview:
```bash
# demo: swap operator pods while streaming KV to new node
kubectl patch sts redwood-operator -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"rollout":"canary-1"}}}}}'
# run kv-transfer job
kubectl apply -f kv-transfer-job.yaml
```

netops-jordan: I'll add the risk matrix to the wiki. Two high-risk items: IP-preserve-mode (legal/compliance), and relay NAT (privacy). Both need escalations.

deploy-bot: Reminder — please add feature flags for Operator shim before merging into main.

maria (PM): Decision check: are we aligned to ship Minimal installer GA first and treat Operator shim as opt-in Beta? If yes, we'll schedule resources accordingly.

lisa (Field): :thumbsup: field OK with that ordering, but call out customers who need the shim early.

sam (SRE): :eyes: we need to confirm load test results before GA.

alex (Eng): Will prioritize the shim spike; will push a PR with tests and a basic runbook.

maria (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll circulate a short RFC with the lanes, ACs, and timeline by EOD. If you have blocking constraints that change priorities, DM me.

lisa (Field): One more: include an explicit upgrade blackout window for tenants that cannot change IPs. We should add that to rollout constraints.

maria (PM): Noted — blackout windows will be part of the canary plan.

netops-jordan: Adding note: for customers on single-AZ setups, relay vs preserve decision differs — I'll include guidance.

alex (Eng): Quick question: do we want to support a config flag "IP_PRESERVE_MODE=true" in the installer for Beta? Less intrusive than enabling BGP by default.

maria (PM): Yes, add it as Beta-only. We'll document caveats.

sam (SRE): I'll start drafting SLO targets for the upgrade lane and include them in the RFC.

maria (PM): Great. Closing thread for now — RFC link will appear here. :rocket:
